The summary of the change names the category as a rule-bound value but does not say whether it follows the rule, and no other instrument reads account data. Without it, a wrong category can pass every answer and reach customers in notices that cannot be undone. I would also have wanted a check, before the release, that the staged set's account rows changed only in status. The summary at A1 covers columns and tables but not which rows were changed. Both are absent from the library, so I have not added them. Total plan cost is 119 of 200: the baseline's 100, plus summary of the change at A1 (14) and trace of an action at A3 (5). I left out same set and summary of the change at A2 and A3 because they read the kept staged set and would repeat what A1 showed. Undo rehearsal at A2 is also left out: it would cost 66 and the A1 rehearsal covers the promotion.
